The '''T7-series droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] owned a T7-series droid.
